direct_or_indirect_leakage_review.delito: Excluded: source text used to derive articulo and categoria.
direct_or_indirect_leakage_review.articulo: Excluded: deterministic source for category mapping.
direct_or_indirect_leakage_review.ley: Excluded: legal/process metadata may encode source offense or case jurisdiction.
direct_or_indirect_leakage_review.estado_etapa_es_archivo_es_preclusion: Excluded: post-report case outcomes not available at incident classification time.
direct_or_indirect_leakage_review.total_procesos: Excluded: aggregate count unavailable for an individual new record and closely tied to aggregation.
direct_or_indirect_leakage_review.departamento_norm_municipio_norm: Excluded: duplicates of retained place fields.
direct_or_indirect_leakage_review.anio_parcial: Retained in the input contract for Flask compatibility; dropped from engineered predictors because it is derived from ano_hechos.

audit.label_quality_note: The target is an approximate legal-article mapping, not an independently adjudicated incident label.

historical_original_random_split.note: Legacy result from a stratified random 80/20 split; it influenced prior model selection and is not an independent estimate.

predictor_policy: Only criminalidad, years, and location are used. No offense text/article, legal outcomes, or aggregate process counts.
feature_engineering: Reporting and entry delays computed from supplied year fields.
Coarse event-year period computed deterministically inside the pipeline.
OneHotEncoder, imputers, and scalers are fitted within each training fold only.
oversampling_decision: Not used: SMOTE is not meaningful for aggregate categorical rows; random duplication could overfit the small classes. Balanced class weights were compared instead.

geographic_test.strategy: Held-out departments using StratifiedGroupKFold; no department shared with development.
held_departments: Archipiélago de San Andrés, Providencia y Santa Catalina

strict_spatiotemporal_test.strategy: Future event years >=2024 within held-out departments; no department overlap with development.

temporal_test.note: This temporal scenario allows recurring crime-location groups across different event years; the primary promotion test is the department-held-out geography test.

promotion_decision_reason: Production model was not replaced. Promotion checks not met: group_bootstrap_95pct_delta_lower_above_zero.
